description: List uploads held for review. The classifier holds a file it thinks shows a secret (an API key, a password, a token) or sensitive personal data (an ID, a card number). A held file stays out of the managed PR comment, feeds, and galleries until a workspace member approves it with `approve`. A signed-in member sees the real file on its /f/ page. On hosted storage an image URL returns a Held for review card, and any other raw URL returns 404. Pass `pr`/`issue` for one PR or issue, or `prefix`. Each item has a `reason` such as `secret: api_key`, and `sha`, the content hash of those bytes. `approve` sends that hash. Same as `uploads approve --pr <n>`.

issue.description: Held files on this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

pr.description: Held files on this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: list_held
title: List held files
